devices.name: Lit ground
devices.purpose: Gives the card a light source, so the hero looks placed rather than pasted.

devices.name: Film grain
devices.purpose: Stops large flat fills reading as plastic on a phone screen.

devices.name: Sunburst rays
devices.purpose: Radial energy. Points at the product without drawing a single arrow.

devices.name: Halftone ramp
devices.effect: dot grid with a quadratic density falloff
devices.purpose: Print texture. Reads as a real flyer, not a template export.

devices.name: Checker field
devices.purpose: Retail-poster ground. Fills the corners the composition never reaches.

devices.name: Diagonal split
devices.purpose: Breaks the rectangle so the eye travels instead of scanning rows.

devices.name: Product hero
devices.purpose: The subject. Without it the card is a price list.

devices.name: Bleed off the edge
devices.purpose: The single biggest anti-blandness move — implies the product continues past the frame.

devices.name: Angle the hero
devices.purpose: Diagonal beats orthogonal. A straight product reads as a catalogue photo.

devices.name: Cast shadow
devices.effect: soft drop at 3.5% of hero height
devices.purpose: Separates the hero from the field so it sits above, not inside.

devices.name: Paint stroke
devices.effect: rough brush quad, wobble on all four edges
devices.purpose: Puts a hand behind the headline. The opposite of a rounded plate.

devices.name: Torn paper
devices.purpose: Divides the card with an edge that looks made, not drawn.

devices.name: Knockout band
devices.purpose: Maximum contrast for one line. The loudest device that still looks composed.

devices.name: Arc crown
devices.effect: headline bent over the hero on a generated arc
devices.purpose: Wraps the type around the product instead of stacking above it.

devices.name: Outline stroke
devices.purpose: Holds the letterform against a busy field.

devices.name: Hard shadow
devices.purpose: The reference-ad signature. Blur makes it a web button; offset makes it a poster.

devices.name: Fit to plate
devices.effect: textLength snaps each line to its box
devices.purpose: Kills the ragged right edge and the empty half-line — the main source of dead space.

devices.name: Starburst seal
devices.purpose: Turns a number into an object. Must overlap the hero or it floats.

devices.name: Ticket stub
devices.purpose: Makes the offer feel redeemable rather than announced.

devices.name: Plate sheen
devices.effect: inset 5% / top 7% / height 9% of its own plate
devices.purpose: Depth on flat colour. Measured from the plate, which is where it used to go wrong.

devices.name: Promise pills
devices.purpose: Answers the three objections before they are raised.

devices.name: Proof block
devices.effect: review card, stars, or numbered steps
devices.purpose: The reason a stranger calls a number on a flyer.

devices.name: Price rows
devices.purpose: The layout resellers actually screenshot and send on.

devices.name: Call to action
devices.purpose: One instruction. Never two.

devices.name: Footer bar
devices.purpose: Anchors the number and the service area. Every reference ad has one.

devices.name: Corner lockup
devices.purpose: Identity without a centred logo eating the top third.
